nav.title: Calling
nav.description: Turn WhatsApp calling on or off for each number.
nav.keywords: call, calls, voice, phone, whatsapp calling, call button

confirm.title: No confirmed calling permission
confirm.body: We don't have a confirmed calling permission on file for this contact.
confirm.callAnywayHint: Works if they already tapped "Allow" in WhatsApp.
confirm.askPermissionHint: Sends them a permission request instead. No call is placed.

toast.noPhone: No phone number on this contact.
toast.noNumber: Calling is not enabled on any WABA number.
toast.alreadyPermitted: This contact already allows calls. Press Call to start the call.
toast.permissionSent: Permission request sent. They will see Accept/Decline in WhatsApp - try Call again after they respond.
toast.acceptInvalid: Could not accept call: invalid call payload from WhatsApp. Try again.
toast.alreadyAccepted: Call already accepted by another teammate.
toast.recordingStarted: Recording started - it will save to Call logs on hang-up.
toast.recordingSaved: Call recording saved to Call logs.
toast.recordUnsupported: Recording is not supported in this browser.

failures.BUSY: The customer is on another call.
failures.NO_ANSWER: No answer - the customer did not pick up.
failures.MIC_BLOCKED: Microphone access blocked - the caller will not hear you. Grant mic permission in your browser and retry.
failures.BUSY_SLOT: Another call is already active in this tab.
failures.INVALID_SDP: Invalid SDP offer - missing v=0 or media line
failures.LOCAL_SDP_EMPTY: Local SDP empty - ICE gathering failed

errors.CALL_NUMBER_NOT_FOUND: This number is not in your workspace any more. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.CALL_NOT_FOUND: This call could not be found. It may have ended already.
errors.CALL_NOT_WABA: Calling works only on WhatsApp Cloud API numbers. This number is connected another way.
errors.CALL_NUMBER_NOT_CONNECTED: This number is not connected to WhatsApp Cloud API right now. Reconnect it under Channels, then try again.
errors.CALL_COEXISTENCE_UNSUPPORTED: A number that is also used in the WhatsApp Business app cannot take calls.
errors.CALL_NOT_ENABLED: Calling is switched off for this number. Turn it on under Calling first.
errors.CALL_META_REFUSED: WhatsApp refused the request. Try again in a moment.
errors.CALL_PERMISSION_REQUESTED: Permission request sent. They will see Accept/Decline in WhatsApp - try Call again after they respond.
errors.CALL_STATE_CONFLICT: Call already accepted by another teammate.
errors.CALL_RECORDING_FAILED: The recording could not be saved.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to use calling.
errors.PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED: Your plan does not include WhatsApp calling.
errors.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.CALL_PLAYBACK_LINK_INVALID: This recording link has expired. Press play again to get a new one.
errors.CALL_RANGE_INVALID: These dates do not make sense: the start must not be after the end, a range can cover at most a year, and the time zone must be a real one.
errors.CALL_OUTSIDE_WINDOW: This contact is outside your calling hours, so no call was placed. The calling window opens {when}.
errors.CALL_LOG_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: This call could not be found.
errors.CALL_LOG_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Give the contact, or a phone number that can be read as a phone number.
errors.CALL_LOG_TIME_INVALID: A call cannot start in the future or more than 400 days ago.
errors.CALL_LOG_NOT_EDITABLE: This call was reported by a phone or a telephony provider, so it cannot be changed.
errors.CALL_LOG_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: The time allowed for changing this call has passed.
errors.CALL_LOG_FOLLOW_UP_NEEDS_CONTACT: A follow-up task needs a contact. Give a number that belongs to one of your contacts.
errors.TELEPHONY_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: This telephony connection could not be found.
errors.TELEPHONY_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: This telephony provider is not available.
errors.TELEPHONY_CLICK_UNSUPPORTED: This telephony connection cannot place calls.
errors.TELEPHONY_CALL_FAILED: The telephony provider could not place the call.

settings.title: Calling
settings.intro: Turn WhatsApp calling on for a number to show the green Call button on its chats in the inbox.
settings.enabledStatus: Enabled - the green Call button now shows on this number's chats in the inbox.
settings.offStatus: Off - turn it on so the Call button appears on chats with this number.
settings.enabledDone: Calling is now on for this number.
settings.disabledDone: Calling is now off for this number.
settings.emptyMessage: Connect a WhatsApp Cloud API number under Channels, then come back to turn calling on.
settings.viewOnly: You can see the calling state of each number. Turning it on or off needs the calling management permission.
